plan: Drive: from Iskut, about 30 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 37.
Park: 57.63331, -130.05629, pull off on Hwy 37 (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 60 m W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.

plan: Drive: from Iskut, about 52 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 37.
Park: 57.50026, -130.22067, pull off on Hwy 37 (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 1.7 km W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 24 m, about 36 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, Aug, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-21, Region 6. Season: moose bulls Aug 23 to Oct 31 and more rows (synopsis page 50, 99%). 2 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-06-12, closures 2026-10-16.

tags.label: Beginner friendly
tags.why: Quieter spot only 1.7 km from the parking: fewer hunters, short walk back (Tip, estimate).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).
